name: Export to CI: the agent's CI tab and the three-step wizard
description: L06 export-ci. Opens a seeded agent's CI tab and walks the wizard end to end: the target step preselects GitHub Actions and shows the other three as unavailable (AC-4, AC-5), the configure step carries the default triggers and post-as (AC-7, AC-9), and Continue generates a real bundle whose files are listed by path with the workflow already open (AC-10, AC-20, AC-21) and copy/download offered for it (AC-22). Read-only: a bundle is a pure derivation and persists nothing, so the flow is re-runnable against a stack it does not own and leaves no rows behind. Not asserted here, because agent-browser has no negative locator: that Continue is DISABLED with every trigger deselected (AC-8) and that the CI tab claims no installation (AC-3) - both live in the client suite.
